title: Fallout 3 Janus Bear — Hash-Bound Effective REFR Acquisition Gate v4.3
goal: Acquire one reproducible effective placed-reference population from Fallout 3 plus all five official DLC masters, bind the exact supplied master bytes and exported inventory by SHA-256, then execute the v4.2 spatial statistics without promoting synthetic tests or wiki examples into real game-wide evidence.

effective_reference_semantics.unit_of_analysis: one logical placed REFR in the effective six-master load state
effective_reference_semantics.overridden_record: only the winning override is included
effective_reference_semantics.winning_deleted_override: logical reference is suppressed and the older record is not resurrected
effective_reference_semantics.location_identity: canonical MasterOrSelf CELL/WRLD identity rather than the physical override file containing the winning REFR
effective_reference_semantics.reason: Physical record versions are provenance; the spatial population must represent effective logical placements rather than double-counting historical override layers.

source_binding.master_binding: SHA-256 and byte size are recomputed locally for each of the six supplied master files
source_binding.inventory_binding: SHA-256 of the complete effective REFR TSV
source_binding.enabled_only_binding: SHA-256 of the deterministic initially-enabled-only sensitivity TSV

authenticity_boundary.reason: Steam, GOG, localization and revision-specific master bytes may differ; this gate binds the exact supplied installation and successful xEdit record structure but does not invent a universal Bethesda-signed SHA-256 allowlist.

mandatory_admission_checks: all six named master files exist
all six master bytes receive SHA-256 identities
effective inventory TSV parses with required columns
minimum production REFR row floor is met
logical REFR identities are nonempty and unique
origin and winning plugin names remain inside the six-master set
each master contributes at least one winning REFR
no winning deleted row is admitted
override counts parse and are nonnegative
teddy, static-skeleton-proxy and gnome target populations are nonzero

analysis_plan.primary_dataset: all effective non-deleted REFRs including initially-disabled placements
analysis_plan.sensitivity_dataset: same inventory with initially-disabled placements removed deterministically
analysis_plan.core: v4.2 exact cell-stratified hypergeometric convolution plus pooled descriptive statistics and geometry diagnostics
analysis_plan.initially_disabled_rule: If statistical classification changes when initially-disabled references are removed, the result is state-sensitive and cannot be presented as an unconditional world-placement grammar.

interpretation_matrix.strong_128_stratified_enrichment: supports a repeated local teddy-to-static-skeleton placement grammar after same-location composition control
interpretation_matrix.only_512_stratified_enrichment: supports a broader neighborhood association requiring stronger geometry/manual scene review before visual-scene language
interpretation_matrix.pooled_signal_but_stratified_null: supports cell-composition confounding rather than a global teddy positional preference
interpretation_matrix.signal_removed_by_enabled_only_sensitivi: supports dependence on conditional/initially-disabled world state
interpretation_matrix.teddy_gnome_stronger_than_teddy_skeleton: supports miniature proxy-social or diorama grammar more strongly than tragedy-witness grammar
interpretation_matrix.gnome_skeleton_without_teddy: supports an independent macabre gnome proxy-actor grammar candidate
interpretation_matrix.no_global_enrichment: retains known manually staged local tableaux but rejects game-wide enrichment in the tested population

current_execution_boundary.reason: The scientific gate requires user-owned game master bytes or a complete hash-bound export. Public lore pages and manually curated examples are not substitutes for the full reference population.
